rounds.scenario: You are a barista who has to tell a customer that their latte is actually a portal to another dimension.
rounds.performance: I will say that, uh, you have a magic drink. You somebody just dropped some drops off or another dimension thing. And you are going into the another dimension. So please stop taking that.
rounds.reaction: Okay — bold commitment, but that felt a bit rushed. Try to make stronger choices next time. Don't be afraid to exaggerate.

rounds.scenario: You are a restaurant waiter who must calmly tell a customer that their order has escaped the kitchen.
rounds.performance: I will, uh, say to customer that, uh, please don't be in a hurry. Be patient. And the order will be soon come as soon as possible because many, uh, workers of mine are currently busy, and I will arrange you your order as soon as possible. So don't be impatient. Be patient.
rounds.reaction: Love that — bold commitment! That was playful and clear. Nice work. Ready for the next one?
